name: Queensland Ballet Under 30 tickets
summary: Queensland Ballet offers an Under 30 single-ticket price, and concession prices for full-time students over 30.
who: People aged 30 and under at the time of booking.
Full-time students over 30 qualify for concession.
how: Book online, by phone on 07 3013 6666, or at the Thomas Dixon Centre, West End.
catches: The page does not state the prices or discount.

source.label: Queensland Ballet: How to book tickets

evidence.quote: Available to those aged 30 years and under at time of booking.
full-time students over 30 years, and the unemployed (healthcare card holders).
Single tickets available with Adult, Concession, Under 30, Child and Group price types.
